rv.q: Tife Kusoro’s fascinating new play thrills and tantalises from the opening moments.
Kusoro won the George Devine award for promising writers, and you can see why: this is a complicated, ambitious and thrilling ride of a play.
A trio of strong, believable performances provides a core of realism in this surreal, modern-day ghost story
Tife Kusoro's new play thrills in all the right ways
Award-winning new writing is full of mystery and metaphor, but a bit too literary
G is a cutting, hilarious thinker of a play

cn.t: Critics praise Tife Kusoro's intelligent urban gothic thriller for its bold ideas and fluorescent dynamism, though some find it overly literary. Most agree it's a cutting, fascinating play that thrills and tantalizes.
